options_evaluated: Overmolded glass-fiber reinforced polyamide with integrated rubber grips
Monolithic high-impact polycarbonate with mechanical fasteners and no overmolding
Cast aluminum alloy housing with elastomer bumpers
assessments.recommendation: Monolithic high-impact polycarbonate with mechanical fasteners and no overmolding
assessments.rationale: This design maximizes in-service durability (a) and functional performance (s) while avoiding overmolded elastomers, which degrade over time into sticky, unrepairable surfaces and shed microplastics (p) during handling. The use of mechanical fasteners ensures ease of repair and maintenance (b) by allowing non-destructive disassembly.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (may prefer overmolding for perceived tactile quality, brand differentiation, and ease of high-speed injection molding).

options_evaluated: Metric machine screws with brass threaded inserts
assessments.recommendation: Metric machine screws with brass threaded inserts
assessments.rationale: This method directly supports ease of repair and maintenance (b) by allowing the housing to be opened and closed repeatedly without stripping the threads or damaging the structural integrity of the casing (a). This prevents the tool from becoming premature waste (r) due to a stripped screw hole during a routine repair or battery replacement.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (higher cost of brass inserts and longer assembly cycle times).

options_evaluated: Brushed DC motor with replaceable carbon brushes
Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with sensorless control
assessments.recommendation: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with sensorless control
assessments.rationale: Brushless technology eliminates mechanical wear from brushes, dramatically increasing durability and reliability (a). It also improves energy efficiency (g) during use, extending battery life per charge, and eliminates the release of carbon dust emissions (q) into the air during operation.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (significantly higher cost for driver electronics, microcontrollers, and rare-earth magnets).

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via integrated aluminum heatsinks and ventilation slots
Active cooling with an internal fan mounted on the motor shaft and removable dust filters
assessments.recommendation: Active cooling with an internal fan mounted on the motor shaft and removable dust filters
assessments.rationale: Active cooling maintains optimal operating temperatures during sustained high-torque use, protecting the motor and battery from thermal degradation, which enhances durability (a) and functional performance (s). The addition of removable dust filters prevents abrasive particles from entering the tool, protecting internal gears and contacts while being easy to clean/maintain (b).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (increased part count, assembly complexity, and physical volume of the tool).

options_evaluated: Fully integrated single-board design with soldered components
Modular architecture with separate plug-and-play modules (battery, switch/trigger, motor, gearbox)
Semi-modular design with soldered wire connections between major components
assessments.recommendation: Modular architecture with separate plug-and-play modules (battery, switch/trigger, motor, gearbox)
assessments.rationale: A fully modular architecture ensures that individual components can be easily diagnosed, accessed, and replaced (b) using widely available spare parts (l). If a single component like the trigger switch fails, the user does not have to discard the entire tool, directly reducing waste generation (r) and lowering the overall environmental footprint of the use phase (m).
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (requires more internal connectors, wires, and structural support, increasing production cost and physical size).

options_evaluated: Removable and standardized slide-on Lithium-ion battery pack with onboard BMS
Hybrid supercapacitor and small internal battery with fast-charge dock
assessments.recommendation: Removable and standardized slide-on Lithium-ion battery pack with onboard BMS
assessments.rationale: Since battery degradation is the most common cause of cordless tool failure, a removable pack ensures the tool's durability and reliability (a) can extend far beyond the battery's lifespan. Standardized slide-on packs ensure high availability of spare parts (l), ease of replacement (b), and prevent the entire tool from becoming waste (r) when the cells degrade.
assessments.potential_conflicts_with: Manufacturing (requires designing around a standardized battery interface, which limits aesthetic flexibility and increases tool weight/bulk).
